subject: Request: Forensics access window for customer debugging
messages:
From: Sara Park <sara@acmehealth.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unable to reproduce payment failure — request for extended logs

Hi Aditya,

We saw a batch of failed authorizations between 2028-06-12T03:20 and 2028-06-12T03:45 UTC while testing a replay of our prod traffic. Our engineers need the raw inference traces and intermediate model kv-cache for two sessions that are now outside our standard 30-day retention. Can Redwood provide a 72-hour forensics access window for the session data (only the two session IDs I list below) so our team can finish the root cause analysis?

Session IDs: AH-7a9b2c and AH-7a9b2d
Scope requested: inference traces, request/response payloads, and intermediate caches for those sessions only.

We understand retention policies exist — we are asking for a timeboxed exception for debugging. Legal is copied on this thread to start the approval path if needed.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Park
Staff SRE, Acme Health
attachments: svc-debug-logs.tar.gz (attachment of server-side redacted logs)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Sara Park <sara@acmehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, legal-procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unable to reproduce payment failure — request for extended logs

Hi Sara — thanks for the clear note and the session IDs. I can escalate and get an exception scoped and timeboxed, but I need to loop in Security and our Legal approvals flow to capture audit requirements. Marissa, Vivek — we have a customer request for a 72-hour access window to session-level artifacts outside our 30-day default. Acme is requesting only two session IDs; they attached a redacted log bundle.

Proposed next steps (quick):
- Vivek to confirm whether Security can authorize a limited export for those two sessions and list the constraints (no download outside approved S3, access logging, RBAC).
- Legal to sign the exception (DocuSign).
- Ops to create a temporary bucket with access TTL = 72 hours and a one-time presigned URL, and we record the action in OPS-4211.

Marissa — can you own the HubSpot/CS touchpoint and ensure product telemetry owners are notified? Vivek — tagging you for policy constraints.

If Security is okay, I’ll coordinate the DocuSign and timeline. We should avoid any cross-region copies and ensure KMS envelopes are recorded.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
Office: +1 415-555-0162

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unable to reproduce payment failure — request for extended logs

Aditya / team — I reviewed the request and we can approve a narrowly scoped forensics access window with the following mandatory controls: 

1) Scope: Only the two session IDs provided (AH-7a9b2c, AH-7a9b2d). No browsing or querying other PII-bearing sessions.
2) Timebox: 72 hours of access from the moment the signed exception is completed. Access will be automatically revoked thereafter.
3) Location and residency: Data must remain in the us-west-2 region; no egress to external storage except the pre-authorized S3 bucket under Redwood account ops-forensics.
4) Audit: All access must be logged and immutable; we will attach a signed audit bundle to the ticket after revocation.
5) Encryption/KMS: Use existing customer KMS policy; any temporary keys must be logged and rotated after the window.
6) Evidence handling: No screenshots or external copies allowed; Acme must confirm deletion of any derived artifacts within 30 days.

I’m attaching a short template that Legal can use for the DocuSign exception and the checklist Ops should follow (forensics-access-template.docx). Marissa, please kick off the HubSpot activity and tag OPS-4211.

If Legal signs and Ops confirms the technical steps, I approve. I will not approve any broader export.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
attachments: forensics-access-template.docx (attachment)

From: Sara Park <sara@acmehealth.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, legal-procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Sun, 23 Jul 2028 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unable to reproduce payment failure — request for extended logs

Aditya / Vivek / Marissa — thank you, this is exactly the level of control we were hoping for. Legal at Acme has initial sign-off pending a short amendment; I’ll send the DocuSign by EOD. We confirm we will not copy or export artifacts outside the approved S3 and will destroy derived artifacts within 30 days.

Action items I’ll complete: sign exception, provide contact names for our SREs who will access the data, and coordinate a narrow replay window. Could you confirm the expected ETA for Ops to provision the temporary bucket after DocuSign returns?

Sara
Sara Park
Staff SRE, Acme Health
attachments: signed-exception-docusign.pdf (placeholder to be returned with signature)
